delta_vs_arm_A.interpretation: The full-ray barrier has a real beneficial causal effect on negative-space support and source coverage overall, but the global min precision is dominated by a new failure localized to the opposite-view 2/6 projection axis.

per_axis_diagnosis.views_0_4: precision improves by about +0.0156; edge max drops from about 148 px to about 42.6 px
per_axis_diagnosis.views_1_5: precision improves by about +0.0091; p95 drops from about 10.44 px to about 7.28 px
per_axis_diagnosis.views_3_7: precision improves by about +0.0084; p95 drops from 24 px to about 9.85 px
per_axis_diagnosis.views_2_6: precision decreases by about -0.00253; p95 rises from about 14.01 px to 19 px; edge max rises from about 65.2 px to about 157.5 px

catastrophic_edge_owner_diagnosis.finding: The ~157 px Stage13 max edge error is consistent with a detached far-background island, not with a global 157 px displacement of the main surface.

training_diagnosis.finding: The barrier drives sampled background rays close to satisfaction, while unsampled negative-space regions can still host unsupported islands. The dominant next owner is sampling coverage / hard-negative discovery before representation capacity is declared primary.

fixed_margin_caveat.finding: A constant +0.04 lower bound is not metric-SDF-consistent for source-background rays immediately adjacent to the silhouette. A future barrier must use a source-distance-aware lower bound m(r)=min(0.04, r*pixel_scale) or an equivalent conservative construction.
fixed_margin_caveat.arm_B_interpretation: Arm B remains valid as a fixed-margin stress ablation; it is not promoted as the final training recipe.

required_next: Replace constant empty-space lower bound with a source-distance-aware metric-consistent bound before any final negative-space recipe is claimed.

Add subject-free deterministic background coverage / hard-negative discovery that can expose spatially localized unsupported islands instead of relying on 32 uniformly random background rays per active view.
Keep Arm A foreground occupancy, historical sparse objective, Stage13-v2 thresholds, architecture and decode apparatus frozen while testing negative-space sampling semantics.
Use component removal only as a diagnostic ablation; do not repair or promote the witness by deleting unsupported learned components.

If dense/coverage-aware negative-space supervision still leaves large unsupported error on the largest connected component, escalate representation capacity / pixel-aligned feature architecture as the primary owner.
